# truenas_service (Resource)

Manages a TrueNAS service (enable/disable, start/stop). Services are not created or deleted: creating this resource adopts the existing service and changes only what the configuration sets, and destroying it (or removing it from the configuration) only removes it from Terraform state, leaving the service enabled and running exactly as it is.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "truenas_service" "nfs" {
  name    = "nfs"
  enabled = true
  running = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name: nfs, cifs, ssh, ftp, iscsitarget, snmp, ups, nvmet, webshare.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the service starts automatically on boot.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the service is currently running. Set to true to start, false to stop.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Service name (used as Terraform ID).
